description: Alerts for new procurements by the company CNPJ (requires the token edm_…): the activities (CNAE) become families of terms, and there is one alert per family, main first, up to max_familias. A CNAE outside the dictionary is listed in the response with a null family. Two modes. By `termos`: a space requires all words, `|` accepts any word of the group (`uniforme|fardamento escolar`). By `cnpj`: the company record gives the activities (CNAE), the dictionary (`GET /api/cnaes`) turns each CNAE into a family of terms, and there is one alert for each distinct family, main first, up to `max_familias`; a CNAE outside the dictionary does not become an alert and is listed in `empresa.cnaes` with `familia: null`. The cron checks every 30 minutes. The email channel requires the account session: the notice goes to the verified e-mail of the account, without a confirmation code, and it exists only with `EMAIL_ALERTAS=1`.

cnpj.description: CNPJ with 14 digits, with or without punctuation.

destino.description: https URL (webhook); ignored for pull and email (email goes to the account e-mail).

filtros.description: Extra filter: modalities, municipalities, exclusions, values, open proposals and CNAEs. PATCH replaces the whole filter; {} clears it.

max_familias.description: 1 to 8 (default 8): how many families become alerts.

name: create_alerts_by_cnpj
title: Alerts by CNPJ
